title: Controlled Prompt Libraries: stewardship, expiry, and delegated review workflow
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: As model and runtime configs change, we rely on curated prompt collections to detect quality regressions. Today our "controlled" prompt libraries (trusted datasets used for evals and gating) lack a clear lifecycle: custodianship is ad-hoc, outdated prompts persist, reviewers are overloaded, and accidental edits slip past audits. This causes noisy regression signals, slow triage, and potential regressions reaching production.

Goal: Define and implement a stewardship model for controlled prompt libraries that includes delegated reviewers, explicit expiry/retirement rules, automated notifications, signed immutable snapshots for gating, and audit trails tied to config/model change events. The work should reduce false-positive regressions from stale prompts, speed up reviewer turnaround, and provide clear playbooks for deprecation and rollback when eval regressions appear.

Scope: This ticket focuses on product policy and orchestration: naming and roles, TTL/expiry metadata on prompt bundles, delegated review flow (owner -> reviewer -> steward), integration points for automated snapshot signing to be used by eval gating, and UI/console hooks for notifications and deprecation banners. Engineering work (APIs, snapshot signing implementation, and eval runner) will be tracked in dependent ENG tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Policy: Written stewardship policy that defines roles (owner, reviewer, steward), review SLAs, and expiry semantics for controlled prompt libraries.
Metadata: All controlled prompt bundles support metadata fields: owner, reviewers, steward group, created_at, updated_at, expiry_date, deprecation_note, and immutable_snapshot_id.

Delegated review flow: Console flow and API spec for submitting a prompt bundle change that routes to delegated reviewers; reviewers can Approve/Request Changes and SLA notifications are emitted to owners/stewards.

Expiry workflow: Console and API support for automatic deprecation banners for bundles within 30/7/1 day windows based on expiry_date, plus an auto-archive option if no steward re-accepts before expiry.

Snapshot gating: Spec for creating signed immutable snapshots that the eval runner can consume during config/model changes; snapshot format, signing authority (steward/team), and verification steps documented.
Auditability: Change history for prompt bundles with links to PRs/drive artifacts and ability to trace which snapshot was used for any eval run tied to a model/config change.
Metrics: Reduce noisy regression investigations attributed to stale prompts by 40% in first 90 days; average reviewer turnaround for gating reviews <= 48 hours after rollout.
Dependencies documented: list of ENG tickets and any design artifacts linked for implementation handoff.
implementation_notes:
Proposed phases: (1) Policy doc and owner/reviewer role definitions; (2) Minimal API/console metadata fields and UI banners for expiry/deprecation; (3) Delegated review flow wireframes and notification integrations (Slack/email); (4) Snapshot signing spec and integration test plan with eval runner; (5) Pilot with two high-traffic prompt bundles and refine.

We will not implement cryptographic signing service in this ticket—this ticket specifies the contract and UI. ENG will build signing & verification (ENG-19804). The console changes should use existing ACL primitives where possible; if missing, raise ENG ticket for RBAC additions.

Edge cases: internationalization for deprecation banners, handling of nested prompt bundles, and emergency un-deprecation for incident rollbacks. Include a manual override path guarded by steward approval.
success_metrics: Primary: 40% reduction in regression investigations attributed to stale prompt content within 90 days. Secondary: 48h median reviewer response for gating reviews; 95% of controlled bundles have active steward assigned. Operational: No more than 2 incidents per quarter where stale prompts caused a missed regression alert.
runbook_rollout_notes: Pilot with two pilot bundles: payments-fraud-promptset and customer-support-intent-bundle. For rollout, disable auto-archive until pilot completes. Provide steward training and a short console walkthrough. If gating snapshots cause a blocking regression, follow Eval Rollback Playbook: urgent revert to previous snapshot, open postmortem, and mark bundle as under review.
